relationships.subject: SCN10A+ nociceptors
relationships.evidence_quote: cells expressing SCN10A had stronger GR mRNA expression

relationships.subject: KCNS1+ Aβ mechanoreceptors
relationships.evidence_quote: KCNS1-expressing cells had strong colocalization with MR mRNAs in human (Figure 5a) and mouse (Figure 5c) DRG

key_findings: GR and MR mRNAs colocalize in nearly all human (99.2%) and mouse (95.9%) DRG neurons.
Nociceptors (SCN10A+) are GR-leaning while Aβ mechanoreceptors (KCNS1+) are MR-leaning, conserved across human and mouse.
